target_customer: Online marketplaces such as trading card platforms, vintage stores and short-term rental operators
problem: Marketplace visitors browse alone and leave. Palisade gives each buyer, seller or owner a personal AI agent that remembers them and follows up.
business_model: B2B SaaS, installed with one script tag (pricing not published)

founders.name: Jonathan Salama
previous_startups: Lulus TV, YouTube channel co-created, 1M subscribers

competitors.name: Zipchat
competitors.traction_then: ranked second in a vendor comparison, from $64 per month

competitors.name: Rep AI
competitors.what: Chat sales assistant Shopify app against cart abandonment

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM agents over a catalog with a script tag install are standard engineering; integrations with booking engines and CRMs add moderate work.

defensibility.rationale: Agent frameworks are widely available and larger vendors ship similar shopper agents; per-customer memory is the only light switching cost.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Big platforms launched shopper agents in 2026. No action against Palisade found.

market_need_then: Agentic commerce was a heavily covered 2026 theme. The company claims over $2.7M GMV driven since the batch began (self reported) and names Shorebreak as a live customer.

branding.domain_note: Uses palisade.run, a .run domain rather than .com.

identity.visual_style: Developer style site with demo agents

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated Palisade companies exist (including a DMARC startup, a risk software firm and an AI safety nonprofit), so the name is confusable and nothing about this brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Palisade is a one person Summer 2026 company with early GMV claims and no disclosed funding, exit or layoff. Large platforms already ship shopper agents and the technology is easy to copy, so the founder must win on marketplace niches. Outcome is open and no factors are assigned.
notes: No funding found. Other Palisade companies (palisade.email raised $1.5M pre-seed; a Highflame product) are unrelated. The $2.7M GMV figure is self reported on the YC page.
